topics.topic: Revocation visibility to requests authenticated before revocation commits
questions: May a request authenticated before revocation commit continue through a project authorization check or mutation performed after that commit?
If a request authenticates before revocation commits but performs its project-access authorization check after the commit, must that request observe the revocation?
If a request authenticates before revocation commits but performs its project authorization check or protected action afterward, must it observe the revocation?

judgement.why: P1 judged the same question about a request authenticated before revocation but authorized after commit, on the same changed text.

precedent.topic: Revocation visibility for requests already in flight at commit
quotes: None; the next guard check sees the revocation.
precedent.why: State 5 explicitly requires the next project guard check to observe a committed grant or assignment revocation, including when authentication occurred earlier.

topics.topic: Validation and normalization rules for supplied ServiceCredential.expires_at
questions: Which supplied expiry values are accepted: must the value already be offset-naive UTC, may an offset-aware value be converted, and must it be strictly later than the operation time or credential creation time?

What supplied ServiceCredential.expires_at values must issuance refuse—for example an instant equal to or before the operation time, an offset-aware value, or an otherwise valid but already expired value?

Which `expires_at` inputs are valid, including offset-aware values, non-UTC offsets, and instants at or before the operation time, and are accepted values normalized before persistence or required to arrive already as offset-naive UTC?

quotes:
The `PortalStore`, the administrator's `StaffActorContext`, the principal id
and an optional `expires_at`. Any expiry is accepted and stored as
supplied, a past one included, never converted (A28 keeps a supplied time); no expiry means the credential does not expire. A
credential is usable only before its expiry, so one issued with an expiry
already reached is stored but never authenticates.
judgement.why: State 5 accepts any supplied expiry, including a past or offset-bearing value, preserves it without conversion, and makes an already-reached expiry immediately unusable.

topics.topic: Audit behavior and actor identity for invalid or unresolvable staff login emails
questions: Does an email rejected during normalization or syntax validation count as an address that matched no account, and must it produce `staff.login_failed` with `actor_id = null`?

For a failed login whose supplied email cannot be normalized or is rejected before lookup, is a `staff.login_failed` audit record written, and if so may it use `actor_kind = staff` with `actor_id = None`?

quotes:
A16 (normalized email), A17 (the session secret is issued for the new
`session_id`; only its hash is stored), R0-06 (fixed expiry of
`config.staff_session_ttl_hours`, twelve hours), A13: once the address has
normalized, exactly one audit on every outcome — `staff.login` success or
`staff.login_failed` rejected with no reason code. A rejection audit names the
account the normalized address matched as both actor and entity, also when
the account is not active, not verified or the password is wrong; actor and
entity are empty only when no account matched, and the actor kind is staff
in every case. Only an active, verified
account with a matching password signs in.

`IdentityInputRejected` for an address that does not normalize under A16,
before any read or audit; it says nothing about any account.
judgement.why: State 5 says malformed or non-normalizing login addresses are refused before lookup and audit; null actor identity applies only after a normalized address matches no account.

topics.topic: Lifecycle state and activation provenance of the implicitly created manual BudgetVersion
questions: What lifecycle state and activation provenance must the implicitly created manual version have?
Is the implicitly created empty manual budget version inactive or active, and, if active, is this read a permitted exception to the rule that activation is explicit?

judgement.why: P4 judged the identical question about the implicitly created manual version's status and activation metadata on the same text.

precedent.topic: Initial status and activation metadata of the implicitly created manual BudgetVersion
quotes:
A18: at most one manual version per project; a new one is `inactive` and is
never activated implicitly; A13 (`budget.manual_version_create` only when it
is created).
precedent.why: State 5 makes the implicitly created manual version inactive and forbids implicit activation, so activation metadata is not populated by this creation.

topics.topic: Required outcome of concurrent implicit manual-version creation races
questions: When two staff progress reads concurrently observe no manual version, must both reads succeed by converging on one version, or may one fail on the uniqueness race?

When concurrent qualifying progress reads race to create the one manual budget version, must all reads succeed using the single resulting version, or may a losing read fail with a persistence/conflict error?

judgement.why: P5 judged the identical concurrency question for racing progress reads on the same text.

precedent.topic: Required outcome of concurrent progress reads racing to create the manual budget version
quotes:
A18: at most one manual version per project; a new one is `inactive` and is
never activated implicitly; A13 (`budget.manual_version_create` only when it
is created).
precedent.why: State 5 enforces uniqueness through persistence and permits a racing request to fail because the resulting persistence failure propagates rather than being retried or converted into success.

topics.topic: Whether ServiceCredential.expires_at is preserved or derived from operation time and TTL
questions: Is ServiceCredential.expires_at stored exactly as supplied, or must the issuing operation derive it from its single clock instant plus a TTL?
When issuing a service credential with a supplied `expires_at`, must the portal preserve that instant or replace it with the operation time plus a TTL?

judgement.why: P6 judged the identical question of supplied versus TTL-derived ServiceCredential expiry on the same text.

precedent.topic: Whether ServiceCredential.expires_at is request-supplied or derived from a TTL
quotes:
The `PortalStore`, the administrator's `StaffActorContext`, the principal id
and an optional `expires_at`. Any expiry is accepted and stored as
supplied, a past one included, never converted (A28 keeps a supplied time); no expiry means the credential does not expire. A
credential is usable only before its expiry, so one issued with an expiry
already reached is stored but never authenticates.
precedent.why: State 5 explicitly preserves the request-supplied optional expiry and defines no service-credential TTL derivation.

topics.topic: Authorization of implicit manual-version creation during archived-project progress reads
questions: Must an archived-project progress read be authorized as a read and commit the exceptional write, or must the active-project requirement reject that write?

quotes:
The one write that is not refused for an archived project
is the empty manual budget version (with its audit) that
`ensure_manual_budget` creates, also when `list_project_progress` reads a
project that has none.

Not a pure read: when the project has no manual budget version, this list
creates it empty with its `budget.manual_version_create` audit, exactly as
`ensure_manual_budget` does, an archived project included; otherwise
read-only.
judgement.why: State 5 explicitly authorizes the archived project as a read and permits the exceptional manual-version write and audit.

topics.topic: Commit versus rollback treatment of the side-effecting progress read
questions: Is this progress-list operation a read path that rolls back, or a write path that commits, when it implicitly creates the manual version?

quotes:
The tracking read transaction closes before
`budget_management.ensure_manual_budget` is called for the order.

Writes one `BudgetVersion` and one `AuditRecord` when none exists; otherwise
read-only.

Not a pure read: when the project has no manual budget version, this list
creates it empty with its `budget.manual_version_create` audit, exactly as
`ensure_manual_budget` does, an archived project included; otherwise
read-only.
judgement.why: State 5 closes the tracking read transaction before invoking a separate operation that commits the manual version and audit, so the created records are not rolled back as read-path work.

topics.topic: Whether viewer sign-out requires a valid session cookie
questions: Does same-origin viewer sign-out require a present, valid viewer session cookie, or is it an idempotent cookie-clearing operation when the cookie is missing, malformed, expired, or revoked?

quotes:
`AuthenticationRejected` for a missing, revoked or mismatched session; never a
successful sign-out.
None (204), only after the server-side revocation committed.
`AuthenticationRejected` (401); a failure never reports a successful logout.
judgement.why: State 5 requires a valid presented viewer session and returns authentication rejection rather than an idempotent successful cookie clear when it is missing or invalid.

topics.topic: Which progress-reading operations trigger implicit manual budget creation
questions: Which staff read operations trigger creation of the missing manual budget version: only the dedicated progress-list operation, or every operation that reads/builds project progress, including ProjectOverview?

quotes:
Not a pure read: when the project has no manual budget version, this list
creates it empty with its `budget.manual_version_create` audit, exactly as
`ensure_manual_budget` does, an archived project included; otherwise
read-only.

A21 (derived at read time, nothing persisted), A27 and Factory
`d2c4511ea119`: a part whose builder answers `ScopedNotFoundError` is
`not_configured`, a persistence or Registry failure `temporarily_unavailable`;
no zero is fabricated; the photo part holds client-visible photos only, for
every reader.
judgement.why: State 5 assigns implicit creation to the dedicated list_project_progress operation while declaring ProjectOverview derivation read-only and non-persisting.
